title: Common definitions
description: Building blocks shared by every record format in this repository: identifiers, people and organizations, money, places, attachments, status history, audit trail and extensions.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: A stable identifier for a record or an item inside one. Letters, digits and . _ : - only, starting with a letter or digit, up to 128 characters. UUIDs and ULIDs both fit.

externalId.title: External identifier
externalId.description: An identifier assigned by another system or registry.

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: The registry or system that assigned the value, for example LEI, EIN, DUNS, UEI, company-number, NPI, or a source system's name.

value.title: Value
value.description: The identifier as the scheme writes it.

dateTime.title: Date and time
dateTime.description: An instant with a time-zone offset (RFC 3339 date-time), for example 2026-03-04T15:20:00Z.

countryCode.title: Country code
countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, upper case.

subdivisionCode.title: Subdivision code
subdivisionCode.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code, for example US-CA or GB-ENG.

currencyCode.title: Currency code
currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code, upper case.

money.title: Money
money.description: An amount of money. The amount is a decimal string so no precision is lost to floating point.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Decimal amount in the currency's major unit, as a string, for example "1250.00" or "-15.5".

personRef.title: Person
personRef.description: A person acting in a role on the record. Give an id when the person exists in another system; the name is what people read.

id.description: Identifier in the system the reference comes from.

name.title: Name
name.description: The person's name as it should appear on the record.

title.title: Title
title.description: Job title or position, for example Chief Risk Officer.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: The organization the person acts for, by name.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Phone number, ideally in E.164 form (+15555550123).

organizationRef.title: Organization
organizationRef.description: An organization: a company, agency, facility operator or other legal entity.

id.description: Identifier in the system the reference comes from.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name the organization trades under.

legalName.title: Legal name
legalName.description: The registered legal name, when it differs from the name.

identifiers.title: Identifiers
identifiers.description: Registry identifiers such as LEI, EIN, DUNS or UEI.

lines.title: Street lines
lines.description: Street address lines, most specific first.

region.title: Region
region.description: State, province or county as written locally.

geoPoint.title: Geographic point
geoPoint.description: A WGS 84 latitude and longitude in decimal degrees.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: Where a rule applies or an authority acts: a country, optionally narrowed to an ISO 3166-2 subdivision and a named locality.

subdivision.description: State, province or other ISO 3166-2 subdivision.

locality.title: Locality
locality.description: City, county or district name, as the authority writes it.

authority.title: Authority
authority.description: The agency or body with jurisdiction, for example Department of Building Safety.

attachment.title: Attachment
attachment.description: A document or file that belongs to the record. The SHA-256 digest lets anyone confirm the file they hold is the one the record refers to.

id.description: Identifier in the system the reference comes from.

title.title: Title
title.description: What the file is, in a few words.

mediaType.title: Media type
mediaType.description: IANA media type, for example application/pdf.

sha256.title: SHA-256
sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 digest of the file's bytes.

uri.title: Location
uri.description: Where an authorized reader can fetch the file. Records shared outside the organization should not carry links that grant access by themselves.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: How the file may be shared: public, internal, confidential or restricted.

attachmentIds.title: Attachment ids
attachmentIds.description: Ids of entries in the record's attachments list.

statusChange.title: Status change
statusChange.description: One change of the record's status.

status.title: Status
status.description: The status the record moved to. Each format limits this to its own status values.

auditEntry.title: Audit entry
auditEntry.description: One recorded action on the record: who did what, when. Systems append entries and never rewrite them.

action.title: Action
action.description: What happened, as a short verb phrase, for example created, field-changed, approved, exported.

field.title: Field
field.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the field that changed, when one did.

from.title: Previous value
from.description: The previous value, as text. Leave out for sensitive fields.

to.title: New value
to.description: The new value, as text. Leave out for sensitive fields.

system.title: System
system.description: The application that recorded the action.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Fields this format doesn't define, for local needs. Keys are namespaced as <namespace>:<field> (for example acme:costCenter) so extensions from different organizations never collide. Readers that don't know a key ignore it.
